description_en: Queries the download link to the traffic data that is captured when a DDoS attack event occurs
description_zh: 获取DDoS攻击事件发生时抓取的流量数据的下载链接
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-cap --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --instance-id i-bp10bclrt56fblts0000 --beg-time 1637812279000 --internet-ip 121.199.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCap

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset that is under DDoS attacks. The asset is assigned a public IP address.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
遭受DDoS攻击的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset that is under DDoS attacks. The asset is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

- **ecs**: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

- **slb**: a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

- **eip**: an elastic IP address (EIP).

- **ipv6**: an IPv6 gateway.

- **swas**: a simple application server.

- **waf**: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance of the Exclusive edition.

- **ga\_basic**: a Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh:
遭受DDoS攻击的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

- **ecs**：表示云服务器ECS实例。
- **slb**：表示负载均衡SLB实例。
- **eip**：表示弹性公网IP实例。
- **ipv6**：表示IPv6网关公网实例。
- **swas**：表示轻量服务器公网实例。
- **waf**：表示Web应用防火墙独享实例。
- **ga_basic**：表示全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset that is under DDoS attacks.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html operation to query the IDs of ECS instances, SLB instances, and EIPs within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
遭受DDoS攻击的公网IP资产的实例ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the DDoS attack event. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354236.html operation to query the start time of each DDoS attack event that occurred on an asset
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS攻击事件的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354236.html查询公网IP资产上发生的所有DDoS攻击事件的开始时间
parameters.name: beg_time

parameters.help_en: The public IP address of the asset that is under DDoS attacks
parameters.help_zh: 遭受DDoS攻击的公网IP资产的IP地址
parameters.name: internet_ip
